surfaces: Learning Supports (text size, focus mode, presets) keep the space welcoming
Encouraging, no-shame feedback tone throughout
Bilingual (EN/ES) access invites every learner to share a perspective

indicators.title: Facilitate clear, standards-based content learning
indicators.l4: Students connect their learning to essential questions, life experiences, or their own identities, and make connections across and within disciplines.
surfaces: Standards-based Content & Language Objectives are stated up front
Connect phase ties the concept to a real-world application
Reflect 3-2-1 asks students for "connections made" and a "question I still have"
Notice & Wonder hook surfaces prior-knowledge connections

indicators.title: Use strategies and tasks to engage students in rigorous work
indicators.l4: Students determine and select strategies that support their own learning needs and goals, with student voice and choice built into grade-level work.
surfaces: Show Your Work strategy chips let students choose their approach
Practice level selector lets students pick their entry level (student choice)
Adaptive practice keeps access to grade-level and beyond
Authored Apply problem gives a grade-level task to strategize on

indicators.title: Use intentional questioning to deepen learning
indicators.l4: Students justify their answers using evidence and reflect on the variety of pathways used to reach them.
surfaces: Show Your Work "How I know" box requires justification with evidence
Reflect prompts students to name "a question I still have"
Notice & Wonder elicits student-generated questions
Turn & Talk stems prompt students to justify their thinking aloud

indicators.title: Monitor progress and provide feedback
indicators.l4: Students correct, clarify, expand, or redo their work in response to feedback.
surfaces: "Check my thinking" self-check prompts students to revise their work
Hint ladder gives Socratic, no-giveaway feedback and invites a retry
Adaptive remediation responds to misses so students can redo work

indicators.title: Facilitate student interactions and academic talk
indicators.l4: Students use academic language and vocabulary as they lead or sustain discussion, and reflect on or adapt how they interact.
surfaces: 5 Turn & Talk prompts with bilingual sentence stems + confidence self-assess
Academic-vocabulary glossary popups support content-specific talk

indicators.title: Organize and implement routines to support a learning-focused classroom
indicators.l4: Students take academic risks, hold their focus through breaks in structure, and follow shared agreements.
surfaces: Consistent Launch → Vocab → Learn It → Practice → Connect → Reflect routine
Self-paced Save/Resume lets students hold focus across days
Calm, no-fail practice lowers the risk of taking an academic chance

surfaces: 5 Turn & Talk prompts with bilingual sentence stems + confidence self-assess
Academic-vocabulary glossary popups support content-specific talk

indicators.title: Organize and implement routines to support a learning-focused classroom
indicators.l4: Students take academic risks, hold their focus through breaks in structure, and follow shared agreements.
surfaces: Consistent Launch → Vocab → Learn It → Practice → Connect → Reflect routine
Self-paced Save/Resume lets students hold focus across days
Calm, no-fail practice lowers the risk of taking an academic chance

indicators.title: Cultivate a supportive learning community
indicators.l4: Students support one another and feel safe sharing a perspective that may differ from others.
surfaces: Learning Supports (text size, focus mode, presets) keep the space welcoming
Encouraging, no-shame feedback tone throughout
Bilingual (EN/ES) access invites every learner to share a perspective

indicators.title: Facilitate clear, standards-based content learning
indicators.l4: Students connect their learning to essential questions, life experiences, or their own identities, and make connections across and within disciplines.
surfaces: Standards-based Content & Language Objectives are stated up front
Connect phase ties the concept to a real-world application
Reflect 3-2-1 asks students for "connections made" and a "question I still have"
Notice & Wonder hook surfaces prior-knowledge connections

indicators.title: Use strategies and tasks to engage students in rigorous work
indicators.l4: Students determine and select strategies that support their own learning needs and goals, with student voice and choice built into grade-level work.
surfaces: Show Your Work strategy chips let students choose their approach
Practice level selector lets students pick their entry level (student choice)
Adaptive practice keeps access to grade-level and beyond
Authored Apply problem gives a grade-level task to strategize on

indicators.title: Use intentional questioning to deepen learning
indicators.l4: Students justify their answers using evidence and reflect on the variety of pathways used to reach them.
surfaces: Show Your Work "How I know" box requires justification with evidence
Reflect prompts students to name "a question I still have"
Notice & Wonder elicits student-generated questions
Turn & Talk stems prompt students to justify their thinking aloud

indicators.title: Monitor progress and provide feedback
indicators.l4: Students correct, clarify, expand, or redo their work in response to feedback.
surfaces: "Check my thinking" self-check prompts students to revise their work
Hint ladder gives Socratic, no-giveaway feedback and invites a retry
Adaptive remediation responds to misses so students can redo work

surfaces: Consistent Launch → Vocab → Learn It → Practice → Connect → Reflect routine
Self-paced Save/Resume lets students hold focus across days
Calm, no-fail practice lowers the risk of taking an academic chance

indicators.title: Cultivate a supportive learning community
indicators.l4: Students support one another and feel safe sharing a perspective that may differ from others.
surfaces: Learning Supports (text size, focus mode, presets) keep the space welcoming
Encouraging, no-shame feedback tone throughout
Bilingual (EN/ES) access invites every learner to share a perspective

indicators.title: Facilitate clear, standards-based content learning
indicators.l4: Students connect their learning to essential questions, life experiences, or their own identities, and make connections across and within disciplines.
surfaces: Standards-based Content & Language Objectives are stated up front
Connect phase ties the concept to a real-world application
Reflect 3-2-1 asks students for "connections made" and a "question I still have"
Notice & Wonder hook surfaces prior-knowledge connections

indicators.title: Use strategies and tasks to engage students in rigorous work
indicators.l4: Students determine and select strategies that support their own learning needs and goals, with student voice and choice built into grade-level work.
surfaces: Show Your Work strategy chips let students choose their approach
Practice level selector lets students pick their entry level (student choice)
Adaptive practice keeps access to grade-level and beyond
Authored Apply problem gives a grade-level task to strategize on

indicators.title: Use intentional questioning to deepen learning
indicators.l4: Students justify their answers using evidence and reflect on the variety of pathways used to reach them.
surfaces: Show Your Work "How I know" box requires justification with evidence
Reflect prompts students to name "a question I still have"
Notice & Wonder elicits student-generated questions
Turn & Talk stems prompt students to justify their thinking aloud

indicators.title: Monitor progress and provide feedback
indicators.l4: Students correct, clarify, expand, or redo their work in response to feedback.
surfaces: "Check my thinking" self-check prompts students to revise their work
Hint ladder gives Socratic, no-giveaway feedback and invites a retry
Adaptive remediation responds to misses so students can redo work

indicators.title: Facilitate student interactions and academic talk
indicators.l4: Students use academic language and vocabulary as they lead or sustain discussion, and reflect on or adapt how they interact.
surfaces: 4 Turn & Talk prompts with bilingual sentence stems + confidence self-assess
Academic-vocabulary glossary popups support content-specific talk

surfaces: Show Your Work strategy chips let students choose their approach
Practice level selector lets students pick their entry level (student choice)
Adaptive practice keeps access to grade-level and beyond
Authored Apply problem gives a grade-level task to strategize on

indicators.title: Use intentional questioning to deepen learning
indicators.l4: Students justify their answers using evidence and reflect on the variety of pathways used to reach them.
surfaces: Show Your Work "How I know" box requires justification with evidence
Reflect prompts students to name "a question I still have"
Notice & Wonder elicits student-generated questions
Turn & Talk stems prompt students to justify their thinking aloud

indicators.title: Monitor progress and provide feedback
indicators.l4: Students correct, clarify, expand, or redo their work in response to feedback.
surfaces: "Check my thinking" self-check prompts students to revise their work
Hint ladder gives Socratic, no-giveaway feedback and invites a retry
Adaptive remediation responds to misses so students can redo work

indicators.title: Facilitate student interactions and academic talk
indicators.l4: Students use academic language and vocabulary as they lead or sustain discussion, and reflect on or adapt how they interact.
surfaces: 4 Turn & Talk prompts with bilingual sentence stems + confidence self-assess
Academic-vocabulary glossary popups support content-specific talk

indicators.title: Organize and implement routines to support a learning-focused classroom
indicators.l4: Students take academic risks, hold their focus through breaks in structure, and follow shared agreements.
surfaces: Consistent Launch → Vocab → Learn It → Practice → Connect → Reflect routine
Self-paced Save/Resume lets students hold focus across days
Calm, no-fail practice lowers the risk of taking an academic chance

indicators.title: Cultivate a supportive learning community
indicators.l4: Students support one another and feel safe sharing a perspective that may differ from others.
surfaces: Learning Supports (text size, focus mode, presets) keep the space welcoming
Encouraging, no-shame feedback tone throughout
Bilingual (EN/ES) access invites every learner to share a perspective

indicators.title: Facilitate clear, standards-based content learning
indicators.l4: Students connect their learning to essential questions, life experiences, or their own identities, and make connections across and within disciplines.
surfaces: Standards-based Content & Language Objectives are stated up front
